items.title: Documentary Filming
items.description: Long-form and observational filming across Afghanistan, from access planning through to a finished cut, paced to the story rather than a deadline.

items.title: Photography
items.description: Editorial and documentary photography for print, digital, and campaign use, shot with attention to context, light, and consent.

items.title: Short-form & Social Video
items.description: Concise, story-led video built for campaigns and digital channels, without sacrificing the documentary integrity of the material.

items.title: Illustration & Graphic Design
items.description: Custom illustration and visual design for reports, campaigns, and communications that call for a considered, editorial hand.

items.title: Post-production
items.description: Editing, color, sound, and delivery handled to the standards expected by international broadcasters and publications.

items.title: Production Support
items.description: Local logistics, fixing, translation, and access planning for visiting teams working on the ground in Afghanistan.
